# GitHub User Fetcher

A sleek, responsive Svelte web application designed to fetch and display GitHub user profiles, statistics, and repositories dynamically using the GitHub API. Built as part of an educational project submission for Alexa Developers SRM.

*(Note: This README file was explicitly generated by Gemini due to time constraints.)*

## Features

- **Profile Card & Repositories View:** Smooth 3D card-flip interaction revealing user details and public repositories side-by-side.
- **Rich User Information:** Displays avatar, user handle (`@username`), bio, company, follower count, and email.
- **Interactive Repository Management:** Lists repositories with quick links, descriptions, primary language tags, star counts, and last updated dates—complete with options to remove items from view.
- **Robust Error Handling:** Detects invalid usernames ("User not found"), handles network timeouts ("Timeout, took too long."), and manages general network dropouts ("Please try again later").
- **Dark/Light Theme Support:** Built with Tailwind CSS and responsive gradient backgrounds.

## Deployment

You can view the live deployment here:
[GitHub User Fetcher Live App](https://alexa-dev-submission.vercel.app/)

## Tech Stack

- **Framework:** Svelte (Svelte 5 Runes)
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS
- **API Integration:** GitHub REST API
- **Icons & Transitions:** Svelte animate/transition APIs

## Getting Started Locally

To run this project on your local machine, follow these steps:

1. **Clone the repository:**
   ```bash
   git clone [https://github.com/Nishant1500/AlexaDevSubmission.git](https://github.com/Nishant1500/AlexaDevSubmission.git)
   cd AlexaDevSubmission

2. Install dependencies:

```bash
npm install
```
3. Run the development server:

```bash
npm run dev
```
##### Open your browser: Navigate to http://localhost:5173 (or the port specified in your terminal).
